about: Labelled claims for the reconciler (contracts/reconciler.md §7). Invented names, the neutral example world (src/personality/world.example.json). Each claim is evaluated on a fresh projection with the clock at writtenAt (world timezone) unless setup.after lists earlier claim ids that are adopted first. 'extraction' is what the stubbed clerk returns (null = no text); 'expect' is the resolver outcome: adopted {as, start (world-local), placeId, castIds, subject (audience name or null)}, tray {reason | reasonIn}, or pending. setup keys: after, meeting {date,time,minutes}, pins, fate {category: mode}, paused, futureAdoptions, reconcilerMode. Every summary ends with (fx-<id>) so a test can assert no summary reaches world_events.
